scope: Secondary cross-industry design track; audit products remain the primary benchmark.
evidenceLimit: Eight public official documentation sources; no commercial app account was signed into, no private screenshot was inspected, and no vendor execution/performance was tested. Audit adaptation and effort estimates are design inferences.

products.name: Linear
products.locator: Custom Views / Create views / Copy view link / Peek preview
products.documented: Saved filtered views, view links and temporary Peek inspection.
products.journey: Filter an issue list, save its view, reopen it and inspect a selected item using Peek.
products.limit: Availability varies by view; saved initiative views are Enterprise-only. Link sharing does not grant access.

products.name: Asana
products.locator: Viewing your project on a timeline / Scheduling tasks / Rescheduling tasks in bulk
products.documented: Dated tasks appear on a timeline; undated tasks remain in an unscheduled section.
products.journey: Open Timeline, select an undated task, assign dates, then inspect it in the list or board.
products.limit: Subtasks need explicit project/date association; timeline depth and layout behavior have documented limits. The page returned CSS-error chrome, but the article body was readable.

products.name: Notion
products.locator: View settings / Open pages in / Add a filter
products.documented: Per-view layout, property visibility and filters; side-peek keeps the underlying view usable.
products.journey: Create a filtered view, choose its visible properties and open a row in a side peek.
products.limit: View settings and sharing choices differ; a presentation filter is not an audit authorization policy.

products.name: Airtable
products.locator: Why use Interface Designer / user roles / adding interfaces
products.documented: Builders configure and publish purpose-specific interfaces for end users.
products.journey: Select a layout and source table, configure a draft interface, publish and grant the intended access.
products.limit: Timeline visualization requires a paid plan; legacy Blank layouts have different capabilities. Interface publication does not define our methodology-adoption rules.

products.name: Attio
products.locator: List entries / Types of list views / Exploring the table view
products.documented: A shared record can have workflow-specific list-entry attributes and table/kanban presentations.
products.journey: Add a record to a list, edit its list-specific status, then inspect the corresponding board position.
products.limit: Repeated entries can represent separate contexts. Automatic enrichment and identity merging are outside this adaptation.

products.name: GitHub
products.locator: Review decision types / Requesting and requiring reviews
products.documented: Review decisions distinguish comment, approval and requested changes; comments may target specific lines.
products.journey: Request a suitable review, discuss an anchored change, then submit a distinct review decision.
products.limit: Code-review access and merge semantics are not professional audit eligibility, clearance or report authorization.

products.name: Google Calendar and Tasks
products.locator: Open two Google products in one window / Close or hide the right side panel
products.documented: A side panel exposes Calendar and task items with deadlines beside other work.
products.journey: Open the side panel, select Calendar or Tasks, inspect or add the relevant planning item, then close it.
products.limit: This supports an interaction reference; our prototype does not claim Google synchronization or sent invitations.

products.name: Slack
products.locator: How notifications work / Choose what to show in Activity / notification schedule
products.documented: Notification relevance and schedules are configurable separately from work content.
products.journey: Choose relevant alert types and delivery preferences, inspect Activity, and pause notifications outside chosen hours.
products.limit: Notification preferences do not change business deadlines or resolve an audit concern. Paid exceptions and platform-specific options differ.
